articles.title: Adaption aims big with AutoScientist, an AI tool that helps models train themselves
articles.summary: Adaption's new AutoScientist tool is designed to let models adapt to specific capabilities quickly through an automated approach to conventional fine-tuning.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: Medicare’s new payment model is built for AI, and most of the tech world has no idea
articles.summary: There is no governmental mechanism to pay for an AI agent that monitors a patient between visits, calls to check in, coordinates a housing referral, or makes sure someone picks up their medication. ACCESS creates that mechanism for the first time.
articles.author: Connie Loizos

articles.title: Kevin Hartz’s A* just closed its third fund with $450M
articles.summary: The firm takes a generalist approach, backing companies across categories such as AI applications, fintech, healthcare, and security. The average check size for this fund will be between $3 million and $5 million, with the aim to back at least 30 startups.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Former Tesla exec and Heron Power CEO Drew Baglino has founded a heat pump startup
articles.summary: Sadi Thermal Machines is Drew Baglino's second startup since leaving Tesla in 2024.
articles.author: Tim De Chant

articles.title: Musk mulled handing OpenAI to his children, Altman testifies
articles.summary: Altman said that Musk's focus on controlling the initial for-profit gave him pause because OpenAI was dedicated to keeping advanced AI out of the hands of a single person, and Altman, with his experience running the prominent startup accelerator Y Combinator, knew "founders who had control usually did not give it up."
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: Anthropic warns investors against secondary platforms offering access to its shares
articles.summary: "Any sale or transfer of Anthropic stock, or any interest in Anthropic stock, offered by these firms is void and will not be recognized on our books and records," the company's support page reads.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: Potholes cost cities millions: This company is using AI and trucks to fix them
articles.summary: Fleet management company Samsara has developed an AI model to detect different kinds of potholes and gauge how fast they're deteriorating.
articles.author: Sean O'Kane

articles.title: Report: Google and SpaceX in talks to put data centers into orbit
articles.summary: Google and SpaceX are in talks to build data centers in orbit, pitching space as the future home for AI compute, even as costs today remain far higher than on the ground.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: Everything Google announced at its Android Show, from Googlebooks to vibe-coded widgets
articles.summary: Google unveiled its new AI-first Googlebooks laptops, more agentic Gemini features, vibe-coded Android widgets, Gemini in Chrome, refreshed Android Auto, and more ahead of I/O.
articles.author: Sarah Perez, Ivan Mehta, Aisha Malik

articles.title: The AI legal services industry is heating up — Anthropic is getting in on the action
articles.summary: Anthropic's new tools are designed to help law firms automate specific clerical functions — things like document search and review, case law resources, deposition prep, document drafting, and other related areas.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Google adds Gemini-powered dictation to Gboard, which could be bad news for dictation startups
articles.summary: Google's transcription feature will initially launch with Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel phones.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Android adds a feature to stop you from doomscrolling
articles.summary: Google’s new Android feature, Pause Point, forces you to wait before opening distracting apps in an effort to curb addictive scrolling habits.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Google unveils Googlebook, a new line of AI-native laptops
articles.summary: The company says Googlebooks, which are launching this fall, are the first laptops designed from the ground up for Gemini Intelligence to offer personal and proactive help.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Google brings agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets to Android
articles.summary: Gemini Intelligence will also include Gboard-based dictation and form-filling capabilities.
articles.author: Ivan Mehta

articles.title: Google launches new Android security feature to help uncover spyware attacks
articles.summary: Intrusion Logging is a new part of Android’s Advanced Protection Mode, which aims to help protect human rights activists, journalists, and dissidents from government spyware attack and law enforcement forensic devices.
articles.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

articles.title: US bank discloses security lapse after sharing customer data with AI app
articles.summary: Community Bank, which operates in Pennsylvania, Ohio, and West Virginia, disclosed a cybersecurity incident that exposed customers’ names, dates of birth, and Social Security numbers.
articles.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

articles.title: Threads tests a Meta AI integration that works similarly to Grok
articles.summary: The feature is designed to help people get real-time context about trends and breaking stories, as well as receive recommendations, all within conversations.
articles.author: Aisha Malik

articles.title: Exaforce raises $125M Series B to build AI for catching and stopping cyberattacks as they happen
articles.summary: As bad actors weaponize AI to exploit software vulnerabilities at unprecedented speed, companies are increasingly recognizing the need to bolster their cybersecurity defenses. The round valued the three-year-old startup at $725 million.
articles.author: Marina Temkin
